note: All dates are our own estimates and can change. An item with a "ships" list disappears by itself once the latest published release of every listed app has reached that version (the Eco app checks this from the real release data).

One voice, part 1: one speaker per topic
items.text: Netra apps on the same phone recognise each other (same Netra signature only) and agree on who speaks. Each topic, like battery percent or temperature, is announced by one app only, never twice. All on the phone, offline, never between different phones.

items.title: One voice, part 2: apps can ask each other for status
items.text: An app can ask another Netra app on the same phone for information it lacks, such as battery or temperature state. Still offline and on the same phone only.

items.title: Battery and temperature check before a game
items.text: Before a KBC game starts it checks battery and temperature with the other Netra apps on the phone. If the phone is too hot the game can pause so it cools down. If no answer comes in 2 seconds, the game is not blocked.

items.title: Festival open animations
items.text: When the app opens on a festival or national day, a short skippable animation for that occasion plays (for example the national flag on Independence Day) instead of a plain banner. Works offline.

items.title: Mic and camera switched off when the screen turns off, and where each app's data goes
items.text: Netra Privacy Guard will cut microphone and camera access when the screen turns off, and will show per app where its data is going.

items.title: No repeated questions and camera indicator for fair play
items.text: KBC will not repeat a question you already saw, and will show a clear camera-in-use indicator for the anti-cheat check.

items.title: Solar and inverter monitoring
items.text: Solar generation, grid and battery status of your home system inside Netra Battery Sentinel Pro. The detailed spec is still being decided with the owner, so this estimate is rough.

items.title: Disaster alerts, part 1: weather orange alerts (India)
items.text: Released fallback in Hub v1.4.12: the NDMA SACHET feed is checked about every 30 minutes, subject to Android delays. Severe or Extreme alerts match district, locality or state names, not coordinates. IMD alerts arrive only if present in that feed; this is not a verified IMD orange/red mapping. The original 5-minute server-driven push design is incomplete. Phone delivery is untested. The 14 Oct 8 PM target was missed; a new completion date is Unavailable until those gaps are verified.
items.status: In progress (fallback released v1.4.12; full scope and phone test pending)

items.title: Disaster alerts, part 2: earthquakes within about 200 km
items.text: What the app does today: a card and a check about every 30 minutes read the USGS feed for quakes of magnitude 2.5 and above within 200 km in the last 7 days, and notify about new ones. It is not an official warning, and smaller quakes in India may be missing. NDMA is not used for quakes yet. In the app since Hub v1.4.x, not yet tested on a phone.
items.status: In progress (in the app, not yet tested on a phone)

items.title: Disaster alerts, part 3: full suite
items.text: More hazards, other countries and states using each country's own government agency, and a public alert report (area name and number of people alerted, never anyone's location).

items.title: H2: steps card and daily step target (released in v1.1.3 to v1.1.5)
items.text: Steps today card and an age-based daily step target from published research are live. Still open: the owner's own target numbers (8000 and 7000, editable), which are not applied yet.

items.title: H3: driving mode and family apps coordination (v1.3.0)
items.text: Driving mode detection that tells the other Netra apps on the same phone to stop background work. Thermal protection always stays on. Netra Privacy Guard is not stopped. On the same phone, offline.
items.status: Released in v1.4.2 (not yet tested on a phone)

items.title: H4: emergency SMS, siren and parking (v1.4.0)
items.text: Emergency SMS to your contacts, a siren with a Stop control, and automatic parking spot saving. Tested in simulation, not in real crashes.
items.status: Released in v1.4.2 (not yet tested on a phone)

items.title: H5: magnetic alerts and final polish (v1.5.0)
items.text: Always-on magnetic alerts and the final polish. Target for the complete Netra Hub release.

items.title: S1: unknown-sources alert and security-patch age warning
items.text: Warns when installs from unknown sources are allowed and when the device security patch is old. We do not patch the OS.

items.title: S2: risky app permission check
items.text: Lists installed apps with risky permission combinations. App-level protection only.

items.title: S3: accessibility-service warning
items.text: Shows enabled accessibility services and flags unusual ones.

items.title: S5: overlay permission check
items.text: Today the app list only tags apps that ASK for the draw-over-other-apps permission. This will check which apps are actually allowed to draw over other apps.

items.title: S6: local VPN website blocking
items.text: On-device website blocking through a local VPN. No outside VPN server, nothing leaves the phone for us. Blocks known domains with a list that updates daily.

items.title: S7: local VPN ad blocker
items.text: Ad blocking through the same local VPN. Adult and gambling domains are always blocked.
